# Space HR

## What is Space HR?
Space HR is an AI-powered HRMS and ERP platform for mid-market enterprises. It automates payroll, performance management, workforce analytics, and employee self-service.

## Who is it for?
- HR professionals, CEOs, CFOs
- Companies with 50-5000 employees
- Teams in US, UAE, UK, Singapore, India, Canada, Europe

## Key Features
- AI HR Concierge chatbot (24/7 employee self-service)
- AI Payroll Auditor with anomaly detection
- Predictive workforce analytics and cost forecasting
- 360-degree performance appraisals
- Leave, attendance, and GPS check-in
- Multi-country tax compliance

## Pricing
Custom pricing based on headcount and modules. Request a quote at https://spacehr.net/pricing
